params.caption: 🎮 Is GTA 6 being censored in Japan? Fans spot red flags Players in Japan have noticed that GTA 6's install size there differs from every other region, and the game's Japanese age rating leaves out sex and drugs. That has sparked fears of a cut version, though neither Rockstar nor Take-Two has mentioned any regional differences. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 19:24 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👍 Like if games should ship uncut everywhere · 💬 Would a censored version stop you buying it? #GTA6 #Rockstar #GamingNews
